newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Infinity ties up with Lehman Brothers.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Infinity ties up with Lehman Brothers.

text.p: South Africa's Infinity Asset Management (Pty) Ltd said on Friday it had concluded deals with Lehman Brothers International's (Europe) division GLG Partners to manage local investors' funds outside the country.

"Infinity, who have appointed GLG Partners as sub-advisors, will, through this arrangement, have access to Lehman Brothers research and offshore asset management capabilities," the company said in a statement.

The South African budget on March 12 gave institutions the go ahead to invest up to 10 percent of their total assets abroad and not, as before, 10 percent of each individual mutual fund, known locally as unit trusts.
Infinity is backed by Genbel Securities and black investment company Worldwide African Investment Holdings.
